title: Navigating the Sea of LLM Evaluation: Investigating Bias in Toxicity Benchmarks

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the rates of harmful classifications by safety classifiers when shifting the benchmark evaluation task from standard direct-response or text-completion formats to a summarization task.

Rephrasing harmful and neutral benchmark inputs into four specific target domains (Finance, Social Media, Chemical Engineering, and Sports) to evaluate if domain-specific vocabulary and context alter the harmfulness judgments of safety classifiers.
